body:
Rule (Termal::Fable2 and Opus2, 2026-11-06): don't write to an Engram item (note, update, child add) while a registered test run on that item is active. Any write moves the work revision, and Engram then refuses that run's verification record with 'registered verification refused (work_revision): work changed since registration'. Coordinators and authors queue their notes until the run ends.

Example: on w-c07c's Windows C4 test-32b54c85 (2026-11-06 02:29–02:59Z), notes and child items written mid-run voided the run's registered credit, though the runtime result was a pass.
